## Relationships

```
accounts (1) ──── (∞) players
  id             account_id
  
accounts → players (DELETE CASCADE)
  When an account is deleted, all associated players are deleted
```

## Common Queries

### Get Account with Players
```sql
SELECT a.*, p.* 
FROM accounts a 
LEFT JOIN players p ON a.id = p.account_id 
WHERE a.id = ?;
```

### Get Account by Email
```sql
SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE email = ?;
```

### Get Players by Vocation
```sql
SELECT * FROM players 
WHERE vocation = ? 
ORDER BY level DESC, experience DESC;
```

### Get Latest Announcements
```sql
SELECT * FROM announcements 
ORDER BY created DESC 
LIMIT 10;
```

## Data Types Reference

| Type | Range/Size | Usage |
|------|-----------|-------|
| `INT` | -2,147,483,648 to 2,147,483,647 | ID fields, counts |
| `BIGINT` | -9,223,372,036,854,775,808 to 9,223,372,036,854,775,807 | Experience points |
| `VARCHAR(n)` | Up to n characters | Text data (names, emails) |
| `TEXT` | Up to 65,535 characters | Longer content (announcements) |
| `TIMESTAMP` | 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-19 | Created/updated times |

## Indexes

Indexes are created for:
- `accounts.email` - Fast login lookups
- `accounts.name` - Fast username checks
- `players.account_id` - Fast player lookups by account
- `players.level` - Fast sorting by player level
- `announcements.created` - Fast sorting announcements by date
